# UDreamScrollBox

<!-- Generated by the DreamGUIReferenceDocs commandlet from reflection. Edit the header, not this page. -->

Inherits from [UDreamUIControl](DreamUIControl.md).

Declared in `Public/Controls/DreamScrollBox.h`.

A scroll box whose hierarchy is code, not an asset.

Three nodes and a bar: a face that carries the box's look, a viewport clipped inside it that holds
the scrolling behaviour, and the content stack that slides within the viewport. It is the dropdown
list's arrangement -- a UUIScrollView on a clipping node with one scrolled column under it --
generalised until the column is anyone's to fill.

BP_HorizontalScrollView and BP_VerticalScrollView are two assets because an asset cannot branch on
a property. Orientation is the branch: it picks the scrolling axis, the direction the content
stacks, and which edge the bar sits on. Deliberately not a third "both" case -- there is no such
preset, a content stack has one direction, and one axis means one bar that can actually reach
everything.

The bar is a real UDreamScrollBar rather than a track and a handle rebuilt here, so the handle
geometry that the anchor-resolution rule dictates exists once. The box only tells it which view to
follow; the two-way link lives in the bar.

## Properties

| Name | Type | Category | In the details panel | From Blueprint | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `Style` | `FDreamScrollBoxStyle` | Scroll Box | yes | `GetStyle` / `SetStyle` | This instance's own look. The project sheet wins while StyleSource says so AND a sheet actually exists; with no sheet in the project this IS the look in effect -- which is why it stays editable instead of being gated on the enum. |
| `Orientation` | `EDreamPanelOrientation` | Scroll Box | yes | `GetOrientation` / `SetOrientation` | Which way it scrolls, and which way its content stacks. One property instead of two Blueprint assets. |
| `bShowScrollBar` | `bool` | Scroll Box | yes | `GetShowScrollBar` / `SetShowScrollBar` | Off means no bar at all, and the viewport keeps the gutter it would have cost. |
| `ScrollBarVisibility` | `EDreamScrollBoxScrollbarVisibility` | Scroll Box | yes | `GetScrollBarVisibility` / `SetScrollBarVisibility` | Whether the bar stays put or disappears while the content already fits. AutoHide follows the content at run time: every re-measure (AddContent, RefreshContentExtent, a resize) asks again, so a box that starts or stops overflowing brings its bar out or puts it away, as UMG's does -- the bar and its gutter both collapse while nothing scrolls. Hidden never draws the bar but keeps its gutter while there is something to scroll, as a Hidden Slate bar keeps its slot; Permanent is UMG's AlwaysShowScrollbar. |
| `ScrollSensitivity` | `float` | Scroll Box | yes | `GetScrollSensitivity` / `SetScrollSensitivity` | Local units travelled per mouse-wheel notch. It used to be documented as a MULTIPLIER and pushed straight into a view that multiplied the raw axis by it, so the default of 1 moved the content one unit a notch -- a wheel that visibly did nothing. 40 is what UDreamLayoutContainerScrollBox already uses for the same gesture. |
| `DecelerateRate` | `float` | Scroll Box | yes | `GetDecelerateRate` / `SetDecelerateRate` | How quickly a flick stops. Zero never slows down; larger stops sooner. |
| `bAnimateWheelScrolling` | `bool` | Scroll Box | yes | `GetAnimateWheelScrolling` / `SetAnimateWheelScrolling` | A wheel notch GLIDES instead of teleporting -- UMG's AnimateWheelScrolling. Off by default, which is what every existing box already does. |
| `WheelScrollAnimationDuration` | `float` | Scroll Box | yes | `GetWheelScrollAnimationDuration` / `SetWheelScrollAnimationDuration` | How long one animated notch takes. Ignored while bAnimateWheelScrolling is off. |
| `WheelScrollMultiplier` | `float` | Scroll Box | yes | `GetWheelScrollMultiplier` / `SetWheelScrollMultiplier` | A plain multiplier on whatever one wheel notch already travels -- UMG's name, and the list controls' too, so the three agree. |
| `ConsumeMouseWheel` | `EDreamScrollBoxConsumeMouseWheel` | Scroll Box | yes | `GetConsumeMouseWheel` / `SetConsumeMouseWheel` | Whether the wheel is swallowed here or handed to an outer scrolling ancestor at a limit. |
| `bAlwaysShowScrollbarTrack` | `bool` | Scroll Box | yes | `IsAlwaysShowScrollbarTrack` / `SetAlwaysShowScrollbarTrack` | Whether the bar's TRACK is drawn while the bar is idle -- UMG's AlwaysShowScrollbarTrack, which raises an idle track from invisible to half its alpha (SScrollBar::GetTrackOpacity). Hovering or dragging the bar draws the track at full alpha whatever this says, and Permanent draws an idle one at half. |
| `bAllowOverscroll` | `bool` | Scroll Box | yes | `GetAllowOverscroll` / `SetAllowOverscroll` | Let the content be pulled past an end and spring back -- UMG's AllowOverscroll. |
| `bBackPadScrolling` | `bool` | Scroll Box | yes | `GetBackPadScrolling` / `SetBackPadScrolling` | A whole window of empty space BEFORE the content, so the first item can be scrolled all the way to the trailing edge -- UMG's BackPadScrolling. A window, not half of one, which is Slate's arithmetic. |
| `bFrontPadScrolling` | `bool` | Scroll Box | yes | `GetFrontPadScrolling` / `SetFrontPadScrolling` | A whole window of empty space AFTER the content -- UMG's FrontPadScrolling. |
| `bEnableTouchScrolling` | `bool` | Scroll Box | yes | `GetEnableTouchScrolling` / `SetEnableTouchScrolling` | Whether a TOUCH drag scrolls this box -- UMG's bEnableTouchScrolling. A mouse drag is unaffected. |
| `bAllowRightClickDragScrolling` | `bool` | Scroll Box | yes | `GetAllowRightClickDragScrolling` / `SetAllowRightClickDragScrolling` | Whether a drag with the RIGHT button scrolls it -- UMG's bAllowRightClickDragScrolling. The drag scrolls from the press, the move that crossed the drag threshold included, as SScrollBox's does, so the content stays under the pointer that grabbed it. Over the content only: a right drag that starts on the box's own bar is the bar's, and the bar answers the left button alone (see UDreamScrollBar::AcceptedMouseButtons), so it scrolls nothing. |
| `bConsumePointerInput` | `bool` | Scroll Box | yes | `GetConsumePointerInput` / `SetConsumePointerInput` | Whether a pointer event this box acted on is swallowed -- UMG's bConsumePointerInput. Off lets it reach whatever is drawn behind the box. |
| `AnalogMouseWheelKey` | `FKey` | Scroll Box | yes | `GetAnalogMouseWheelKey` / `SetAnalogMouseWheelKey` | The analog key that acts as this box's mouse wheel -- UMG's AnalogMouseWheelKey. Invalid (the default) means "whatever the input preset already routes here", which is the right stick and therefore exactly what every existing box does. |
| `ScrollWhenFocusChanges` | `EDreamUIScrollWhenFocusChanges` | Scroll Box | yes | `GetScrollWhenFocusChanges` / `SetScrollWhenFocusChanges` | What this box does when user focus lands inside it -- UMG's ScrollWhenFocusChanges. |
| `NavigationDestination` | `EDreamUIScrollDestination` | Scroll Box | yes | `GetNavigationDestination` / `SetNavigationDestination` | Where a widget revealed by NAVIGATION ends up -- UMG's NavigationDestination. IntoView moves the least distance that shows it; the other two always frame it the same way. |
| `NavigationScrollPadding` | `float` | Scroll Box | yes | `GetNavigationScrollPadding` / `SetNavigationScrollPadding` | How much of the window to keep clear around it -- UMG's NavigationScrollPadding. |
| `ScrollProgress` | `float` | Scroll Box | yes | `GetScrollProgress` / `SetScrollProgress` | Position along the scrolling axis, 0 to 1. Authored in; mirror of the behaviour's out, so a `.dui` binding and the designer can both see it. |
| `FaceNode` | `TObjectPtr<UDreamWidget>` | Scroll Box | - | read only |  |
| `ViewportNode` | `TObjectPtr<UDreamWidget>` | Scroll Box | - | read only |  |
| `ContentNode` | `TObjectPtr<UDreamWidget>` | Scroll Box | - | read only |  |
| `ScrollBarNode` | `TObjectPtr<UDreamScrollBar>` | Scroll Box | - | read only |  |
| `ScrollView` | `TObjectPtr<UUIScrollView>` | Scroll Box | - | read only |  |
| `ContentStack` | `TObjectPtr<UDreamLayoutContainerStackBox>` | Scroll Box | - | read only |  |

## Events

| Event | Signature | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `OnScrolled` | `void DreamScrollBoxScrolledEvent__DelegateSignature(float Progress)` | Re-broadcast from the scroll behaviour, so a consumer binds to the control, not to a part of it. |
| `OnUserScrolled` | `void DreamScrollBoxUserScrolledOffsetEvent__DelegateSignature(float CurrentOffset)` | The USER moved it -- UMG's OnUserScrolled, and its unit, which is an OFFSET rather than a progress. |
| `OnScrollBarVisibilityChanged` | `void DreamScrollBoxBarVisibilityChangedEvent__DelegateSignature(bool bVisible)` | The bar appeared or went away -- UMG's OnScrollBarVisibilityChanged. Fired from the style push, which is the one place that decides, and only when the answer actually moved. |
| `OnFocusUpdated` | `void DreamScrollBoxFocusUpdatedEvent__DelegateSignature(UDreamWidget* FocusedWidget)` | Focus moved to something INSIDE the box -- UMG's OnFocusUpdated. |
| `OnValueChangedBP` | `void DreamScrollBoxScrolledEvent__DelegateSignature(float Progress)` | The `<->` convention: a two-way binding synthesizes its reverse route against this exact name. A scroll box's value is where it is scrolled to, so it carries one and fires it with OnScrolled. |

## Compared with UMG

Every Blueprint-facing member of the UMG class, and where it went. *adopt*: same name, same meaning. *map*: here under another name or on another type. *reject*: deliberately absent, with the reason.

| UMG | Member | Status | Here | Note |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `UScrollBox` | `ScrollAnimationInterpolationSpeed` | map | `WheelScrollAnimationDuration` | An eased scroll here glides over a fixed DURATION rather than interpolating at a fixed speed, so the knob is a duration. Same feel, different parameterisation; UDreamLayoutContainerScrollBox carries the speed-based form under UMG's name for the layout road. |
| `UScrollBox` | `bEnableTouchScrolling` | adopt | `bEnableTouchScrolling` | Pushed to UUIScrollView::bEnableTouchScrolling; the gate is the event system's current input device, because a finger and a mouse both arrive as pointer 0. |

| `UScrollBox` | `AnalogMouseWheelKey` | adopt | `AnalogMouseWheelKey` | Invalid by default = whatever the input preset routes here (the right stick), which is today's behaviour. A named key narrows it; the preset only binds the right stick's two axes, so any other key needs a project binding. |

This library has no Slate visibility enum. AutoHide follows the content: every re-measure (AddContent, RefreshContentExtent, a resize) asks again, so the bar comes out or goes away -- its gutter with it -- when the content starts or stops overflowing, as SScrollBar's does. Hidden never draws the bar and keeps its gutter while there is something to scroll, as a Hidden Slate bar keeps its slot; the box still scrolls by wheel, drag and code. |

It keeps neither the bar nor its gutter while nothing scrolls -- only ScrollBarVisibility Permanent does. |
